title: Omugabi w’Amagezi Agataliiko Kiseera
intro: Omusajja ow’ekitiibwa, amanyiddwa olw’okutegeera kwe okw’amaanyi n’okuwa amagezi ag’amagezi, lumu yawa amagezi agasukka emirembe. Ebigambo byabwe, ebiwandiikiddwa mu byawandiikibwa ebitukuvu, bilungamya abantu ssekinnoomu eri okwebaza, obugumiikiriza, n’empisa entuufu.
clues: Naweebwa omukisa n’amagezi, so si bwa nnabbi.
Nawabula omwana wange ku bibi ebisinga obunene: okugatta ababeezi ne Allah.
Nayigiriza ku buzito bw’ebikolwa, wadde omuwendo gwa mukene, n’engeri Allah gy’anaaguggyamu.
Naggumiza okwebaza Allah n’abazadde b’omuntu, nga nkiriza entalo z’okukuza omwana.
Okubuulirira kwange kwalimu okussaawo okusaba, okulagira ebirungi, okugaana ebibi, n’okugumiikiriza n’obugumiikiriza ekyo ekituuka ku muntu.
Essuula mu Quran etuumiddwa erinnya lyange, erimu enjigiriza zange n’eby’okuyiga bye nnagabana.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
